description: This file contains implementations related to the RFC4616 PLAIN authentication mechanism in the cURL project, including functions for creating authentication messages used in protocols like IMAP, SMTP, POP3, and LDAP.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_plain_message(const char * authzid,const char * authcid,const char * passwd,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Generates an encoded PLAIN authentication message suitable for transmission, based on provided authorization ID, authentication ID, and password.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_create_login_message(const char * valuep,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Creates an encoded LOGIN message with the username or password.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_create_external_message(const char * user,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Creates an encoded EXTERNAL message with the username for authentication.

ctags.name: Curl_auth_create_plain_message
ctags.signature: (const char * authzid,const char * authcid,const char * passwd,struct bufref * out)
